summary: Every acceptance criterion has its implementing work: V02 (P1–P4), V03/V04/V13 (P5–P9, ZigbeeControl #60 proving D1), V05/V06 (green builds with unchanged test counts), V07 (a grep over every sibling finds only records, the ModernAppTemplate changelog and the Ansible config comment that cites this slice), V08 (P11), V09 (P10), V10 (P12) and V12. V11 is the operator's step after the run. The sweep's only RED rows, ElectronicsInventory's backend and frontend test, are the missing S3 service at localhost:9000 that ruling S1 covers explicitly, and it forbids a phase for them. The consult re-ran the backend suite to confirm this. 4bbec200 is already origin/main, proven by Jenkins #255, so the test phase pushes nothing there. Every branch it does push (DockerImages, ArgoCDTools, Ansible, AnsibleSpecs) swept green or had no gate. Close-out: A1, A3 and A4 are struck as resolved, B2 is noted as priced out of a phase, and S6 is added (drop the slice-030 checkouts from Ansible's config).
